evidence: Template library shows 6 templates, each with author (e.g. "Sarah Chen"), description, category/scenario tags, usage count, update date.
Clicking "Use Template" on Professional Resume opened a dialog with Fill Template / Preview Result tabs for that template.
Each card shows name (Professional Resume), author (Sarah Chen), description, type tag (Resume/Business), and "Updated 2024-12-01".
With required fields empty, "Preview Result" tab is disabled and a banner reads "Required fields missing... Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, ...".
Warning banner "Required fields missing" with list of missing fields displayed when form incomplete; Preview tab disabled.

issue: Special characters not filtered or blocked
actual: Typing "John#@%Doe" into the Full Name field was accepted verbatim with no filtering and no "Special characters are prohibited" message.

issue: No visual feedback when entering special characters
actual: Entering special characters (#@%) in Full Name field produced no warning, highlight, or blocked input.
Entered "2025-13-45" (invalid month/day) into Start Date field; no error was shown and the Preview tab became enabled, indicating no date format validation.
Entered Start Date "2025-13-45" and End Date "2020-01-01" (end before start); no validation error appeared and Preview tab was enabled.

evidence: All form fields for Professional Resume template accepted input via textboxes.
Preview Result tab shows rendered resume with Name, Job Title, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills matching entered data.
Preview shows headings (H1, H2, H3), bold/emphasis, and separators correctly rendered from the underlying Markdown template with the filled data merged in accurately.
Markdown template rendered with proper heading levels, bold, emphasis, and separators without formatting errors.
Clicking "Copy to Clipboard" invoked navigator.clipboard.writeText with the full rendered Markdown content (verified by patching writeText).
After clicking the heart icon on Professional Resume, its button gained class "bg-primary/10 text-primary" and the heart svg gained "fill-current", providing clear visual feedback of favorited state.
Clicking the heart/favorite icon on a template card toggles its favorited state (style change confirms persistence in state).
Clicking Favorites header button filtered the list to show only the favorited "Professional Resume" template ("Showing 1 of 6 templates"), and search worked within that view.
Typing "Resume" in search box produced a real-time suggestion dropdown widget showing "Professional Resume".
Typing "Resume" immediately filtered results and displayed a live suggestion list without needing to submit.

issue: Suggestion click does not redirect to the template
actual: Clicking the "Professional Resume" suggestion only filled the search box and filtered the list to show that one template; it did not open/navigate to the template's detail or fill page (URL and view remained the library page).

evidence: Category filter (Resume→1/6), Scenario filter (Academic→1/6), and Sort By (Recently Updated correctly reordered by update date descending) all worked correctly.
Clicking "Submit Template" with empty Title, Author, and Content fields triggered a toast: "Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields." and the submission was blocked.

issue: No Markdown syntax validation before submission
actual: Submitted template content included malformed Markdown ("[Broken link(http://example.com" - invalid link syntax), yet the submission succeeded with toast "Template submitted!" and no syntax validation error/warning was shown.

evidence: Submitted a custom Markdown template with title, author, description, category/scenario, content, and dynamic fields; submission succeeded with confirmation toast.
After submission, "Simple Cover Letter" by QA Tester appeared as a new card in the template library, changing count from 6 to 7 templates.
Library list updated immediately after submission ("Showing 7 of 7 templates") without requiring a page reload, showing the new template first (sorted by Recently Updated).
